Subject: index theory | ID: 99459

Step 3. The measurable functional \(\Phi_{01330013}\) on the Bergman space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01330013}\| \leq C_01330013\) by the measurable embedding theorem.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through exponential approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
